cli.list.short: Show tracked paths and Docker containers, soonest expiry first
cli.list.stopped: stopped retrying after {{.Attempts}} attempts: {{.Error}}; obit extend #{{.ID}} 1m tries again, obit spare #{{.ID}} stops tracking
cli.bury.short: Move paths using the configured deletion mode; recovery depends on that mode
cli.bury.short.graveyard: Move paths into the graveyard now (restore with obit resurrect)
cli.bury.short.recycle: Move paths to the system Recycle Bin (restore from the Recycle Bin)
cli.bury.force: allow folders that contain a .git repository
cli.bury.note: free-text note kept with the burial
cli.bury.recycled: {{.Action}}  {{.Ref}}  (sent to the system Recycle Bin; restore from the Recycle Bin)
cli.resurrect.short: Restore files without overwriting; start buried Docker containers by ID
cli.resurrect.last: restore the latest deletion batch in the current session or Git project
tray.missing_gui: No usable obit-gui.exe; place it beside obitd.exe: %s. Run obit doctor to check.
tray.recent_hint: Select a record to resurrect it
tray.pause_hint: Pause automatic burial and purging; operations already committing will finish
tray.summary: Next 24 hours: %d to bury · %d in the graveyard
tray.summary_paused: Paused, nothing is buried · %d in the graveyard
telemetry.help: Usage statistics: a random installation ID, version, OS, architecture, interface language and installation channel help measure installation counts and version use. No files, paths or commands are sent; IP addresses and user agents are not stored. Disable with obit config telemetry off or OBIT_TELEMETRY=0.
telemetry.syntax: Use obit config telemetry on or obit config telemetry off.
